foreign exchange receipt, foreign currency revenue (income received in foreign currency, typically from exports or foreign tourists)
Für viele Entwicklungsländer ist der Export von Rohstoffen die primäre Deviseneinnahme.
For many developing countries, the export of raw materials is the primary foreign exchange receipt.
Durch den starken Sommertourismus stiegen die staatlichen Deviseneinnahmen spürbar an.
Due to strong summer tourism, state foreign currency revenues rose noticeably.
foreign exchange expenditure (the spending of foreign currency, typically for imports, foreign investments, or travel abroad)
Die steigenden Energiepreise führten zu einer massiven Erhöhung der staatlichen Devisenausgaben.
The rising energy prices led to a massive increase in state foreign exchange expenditures.

In order to protect the national currency, the central bank tried to limit every unnecessary foreign exchange expenditure.
foreign exchange rate, forex rate (the price of one currency expressed in terms of another currency)
Der Devisenkurs des Euro gegenüber dem Dollar ist nach den neuesten Wirtschaftsdaten leicht gestiegen.
The foreign exchange rate of the euro against the dollar rose slightly after the latest economic data.
Unternehmen sichern sich gegen Schwankungen beim Devisenkurs ab, um Planungssicherheit im Außenhandel zu haben.
Companies hedge against fluctuations in the foreign exchange rate to have planning certainty in foreign trade.
foreign exchange market, forex market, FX market (a global decentralized or over-the-counter market for the trading of currencies)
Der Devisenmarkt ist mit einem täglichen Handelsvolumen von mehreren Billionen Dollar der größte Finanzmarkt der Welt.
The foreign exchange market is the largest financial market in the world, with a daily trading volume of several trillion dollars.
Zentralbanken intervenieren gelegentlich am Devisenmarkt, um die eigene Währung zu stützen.
Central banks occasionally intervene in the foreign exchange market to support their own currency.
currency speculation, forex speculation (the act of purchasing or selling a foreign currency with the expectation that its value will change, in order to profit from the exchange rate fluctuations)
Riskante Devisenspekulation kann innerhalb kürzester Zeit zu massiven Verlusten führen.
Risky currency speculation can lead to massive losses within a very short time.

Some hedge funds have specialized in currency speculation against weakening currencies.
